In this work, we compare manual CADs to automated CADs generated from Polyjuice , ChatGPT, and Flan-T5  as training data for harmful language detection models, specifically sexism and hate speech detection.
datasets: Vidgen et al. hate speech dataset
Qian et al. hate speech datasets (Reddit and Gab)
outputs: counterfactual examples (CADs) for sexism and hate speech detection
Counterfactually augmented texts (CADs) that flip the label of the original instance
The paper generates counterfactual text instances by making minimal changes to original texts to flip their labels (e.g., from sexist to non-sexist).

we conducted a manual assessment of 100 automated CADs for each CAD generation technique for each construct, i.e., 300 CADs for sexism and 300 for hate speech. Two of the paper's authors manually and independently labeled the CADs without looking at the original instance.

We conducted a manual assessment of 100 automated CADs for each CAD generation technique for each construct... Two of the paper's authors manually and independently labeled the CADs without looking at the original instance. We calculated the initial agreement, measured using Cohen's κ...

Two of the paper's authors manually and independently labeled the CADs without looking at the original instance. We calculated the initial agreement, measured using cohen's κ, which came out to be 0.67 for sexism and 0.76 for hate speech, indicating substantial agreement. Disagreements were then resolved based on discussions.
guideline: Label the CADs as sexist or non-sexist (for sexism) or hate or not hate (for hate speech) to determine if the label was flipped correctly.
Annotators independently labeled each CAD to determine whether it correctly flips the original label (i.e., whether it is mislabeled).

The annotators were instructed to label whether the CAD flips the original instance's label (e.g., from hateful to non-hateful) without seeing the original instance, to assess correctness of label flipping.
criteria: label correctness (whether CAD flips the original label)
